_comment: The vct-cli command tree: top-level verb -> its subcommands, exactly as clap builds them (auto `help` included). Proven against the real parser by `verb_table_matches_the_parser` in src/main.rs; read by tests/test_v0297_cli_program_names.py to check every `vct-cli <verb>` and `vco <verb>` in shipped text. Change a verb in src/main.rs and this file must change with it.
